label: Curved 8.0 cm
description: The Curved collar at 8.0cm features points that follow a gentle concave arc from the collar band outward, rather than projecting in a straight line. This subtle curvature gives the collar a softer, more naturalistic silhouette that moves with the body and tends to lie flat without collar stays. It is a hallmark of traditional British and some Neapolitan shirtmaking, conveying a relaxed formality that ages exceptionally well.
